answeredQuestions.track-scope: Separate Microsoft Foundry evaluation learning track; preserve the introduction track progression.
answeredQuestions.target-users: Consultants, delivery engineers, and solution architects have equal priority. Also support operators and facilitators.
answeredQuestions.learner-prerequisites: Basic Foundry knowledge; no prior track completion or Python authoring. Running supplied scripts is allowed and source remains available.
answeredQuestions.working-scenario: Passenger-facing flight-disruption advice using synthetic data, fictional policy, and read-only tools. Exclude booking, claim submission, and legal-entitlement advice.
answeredQuestions.primary-outcomes: Run evaluations, generate/review/change rubrics, explain results and limits, investigate failures, verify an agent quality improvement, and make reasoned decisions.
answeredQuestions.production-and-cicd-scope: Hands-on evaluation of live lab-agent activity is core. A real GitHub Actions evaluation workflow is a required track deliverable with optional learner participation. Optimizer and controlled red teaming are secondary.
answeredQuestions.provisioning-boundary: Required infrastructure provisioning is pre-work. The agent readiness check remains within the timed core.
answeredQuestions.duration-target: Less than 120 minutes, including readiness, expected waits, and contingency. The proposed 119-minute budget is not measured.
answeredQuestions.feature-coverage-aim: Approximately 80% is a breadth aim. No feature denominator or measured coverage is agreed.
answeredQuestions.introductory-examples: Use labelled supplied acceptable/unacceptable answers and explain why. Real evaluations on those answers do not satisfy live-agent improvement or production evidence.
answeredQuestions.rubric-authoring-support: Supply quality priorities and fictional policy. Foundry generates a starting rubric; learners review and refine it instead of writing all criteria from scratch.
answeredQuestions.rubric-change-support: Supply one additional requirement for learners to incorporate and test. The exact requirement remains open. Comparing unchanged answers under both rubric versions is a coach recommendation.
answeredQuestions.opening-order: Run Understand Customize: an actual simple built-in evaluation and result review precede rubric generation, comparison, and guided revision.
answeredQuestions.prd-refinement-with-method-6-incomplete: Ok, you're now the PRD builder - proceed leaving Method 6 incomplete.
answeredQuestions.official-documentation-alignment: Current official Microsoft documentation for Foundry, evaluations/evaluators, Agent Optimizer, AI Red Teaming Agent, and related capabilities used MUST be consulted throughout Research, Plan, Implement, and review. CON-009 requires source-linked decisions, check dates, applicable versions/support limits, repeated checks, and explicit handling of documentation differences.
